sources.description: SYNTHETIC instrument export with injected storage/encoding faults
SYNTHETIC data dictionary: keys, sentinels, units, QC rules

operations.rule: dictionary p2: sentinels are faults/missing, not measurements; true 0 is valid
operations.reason: distinguish not-detected / below-LOD / missing entry / fault from true zero; no imputation

operations.rule: primary key = sample_id + timestamp (dictionary p1); keep first export
operations.reason: S001 exported twice; first export authoritative, removed row logged in full

operations.rule: 1 mg/L = 1000 ug/L; reversible (inverse_expr logged); original preserved
operations.reason: harmonize to dictionary target unit ug/L
harmonize unit variant to target ug/L

operations.rule: Tukey IQR fence k=1.5 on cleaned ug/L values; flag only, no deletion
operations.reason: 250 mg/L spike may be real high value or pipetting error; flag for human review

uncertainty.reason: IQR-flagged high value (250000 ug/L) could be a real extreme or a pipetting error; retained and flagged
uncertainty.impact: downstream statistics sensitive to this point

uncertainty.reason: S004 detected-as-0 falls below the lower IQR fence; dictionary p2 says 0 is valid, so it is retained despite the diagnostic flag

provenance.pipeline: actual material -> IR -> validate -> clean -> quality report (self-checked) -> result
